# ARTIDOM — Custom Furniture Workshop in Montenegro

> Custom kitchens, wardrobes and apartment furnishing. Workshop in Bar, serving all of Montenegro.

## Canonical answer

ARTIDOM is a custom furniture workshop in Zaljevo, Bar, Montenegro. The company makes custom kitchens, wardrobes, built-in storage and apartment furnishing packages for owners, investors and rental properties, with measurement and installation across Bar, Budva, Tivat, Kotor, Podgorica and the Montenegro coast. Typical production lead time is 3-5 weeks after drawings, materials and measurements are approved.
